timeline.message:
Fix for #3667
Replace deprecated stat64 symbols with stat symbols
timeline.author: Johan Vos

timeline.body: This PR fixes #3667 by replacing stat64 symbols with stat symbols on Darwin.
Thank you for contributing to GraalVM, this PR is tracked internally on GR-33126

> Thank you for contributing to GraalVM, this PR is tracked internally on GR-33126

Is there a way to follow what is happening with this (in case it is done internally)?

reply.body: Thanks for the comment. This patch works as well (that is, there is no Unresolved fstat64 in the objectfile anymore), so if that is less intrusive, I'm very ok with that.
